f2-coastal-cargo-vessel-maintenance-0-full-layers
{
  "version": "brickatlas-diagnostic-2",
  "id": "f2-coastal-cargo-vessel-maintenance-0-full-layers",
  "sourceGroup": "coastal-cargo-vessel",
  "condition": "layers",
  "prompt": "Diagnose the current assembly against the supplied reference, certify the minimum access set,\nand repair it under vertical-only removal/insertion. Return {diagnosis:{faultIds,replacements},\naccess:{removeIds,order},repair:{actions:[{op,id,part?}]}}. Coordinates are integer studs X/Z and plate heights Y.\nEach elevated part needs direct support; overlapping overhead parts block vertical access.\nNo in-place repaint. Remove puts an instance into inventory. Place consumes it at its current pose,\nor at the optional supplied replacement Part with the SAME ID. No collision; each elevated part\nneeds a direct supporting stud. Only vertical removal/insertion; any overhead\nfootprint overlap blocks passage. This is nominal geometry, not force or robot physics.\nIDs identify tracked instances in actions; geometry answers accept symmetric yaw.\nReturn one JSON object. All task budgets and information privileges are explicit.\nSchedule all IDs in synchronous rounds with four abstract workers. Prerequisites are every lower part whose footprint overlaps; ALL must be in earlier rounds. At most four IDs per round; each ID once. Return {batches:[IDs]}. Score legality, coverage and deadline separately.",
